regime_context: Canada/TSX shows a broad, non-directional rotation with Base Metals & Copper narrowly leading Oil & Gas Producers (margin 0.11, absorption 0.3 — low conviction in the handoff). The absolute-trend gate is validated for this market (gate_helps: true), so the useful signal is eligibility/staying-power, not the rank order. Momentum ranks are an attention lens only; nine of sixteen themes are eligible, 56% breadth, no single dominant narrative.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Oil & Gas Producers closes the 0.11 leadership margin and claims rank #1 from Base Metals with breadth staying above 0.55 — a confirmed handoff that would retire this watch if XEG.TO takes the lead for 5 consecutive sessions while XBM.TO's score declines.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas Producers rank #2 with the strongest durability_bar (0.61) among eligible leaders, a trend/mixed hurst tag, and the highest breadth (0.571). While Base Metals leads on raw score, oil's cohesion and staying-power leg (the only validated edge) make it the more defensible trend-eligible lean for a vol-aware stance.
evidence: breadth 0.571 — best breadth in the eligible set
hurst_tag 'mixed' with crowded: false (no fade risk flag)
theses.dissent: Base Metals has the higher rank score and a marginal lead; oil's mixed hurst tag means the trend is not cleanly persistent, and the challenger margin is too thin to call a confirmed handoff.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO falls below its 20-day trailing level while XBM.TO holds rank #1 at the check-by date

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals & Copper leads the rotation (rank #1, score 1.655) and is eligible with a mean-revert hurst tag and moderate breadth (0.556). As the confirmed leader, a modest overweight aligns with trend-following discipline, but mean-revert texture and thin leadership margin argue for low conviction rather than conviction in continuation.
evidence: leader in rotation object with margin 0.11 over challenger
theses.dissent: Mean-revert hurst tag suggests the leader may revert; the 0.11 margin over oil is too thin to claim durable leadership, and crowding_z 0.9 is elevated (though not a crowded flag) — extension risk near the top.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO loses rank #1 to XEG.TO and falls below its own 20-day trailing level before the check-by

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners rank #3 (score 1.07) and are eligible, but show weak breadth (0.4) and a mean-revert hurst tag with durability_bar 0.48 — all suggesting leadership is thin and unlikely to persist. In a vol-aware framework, the staying-power leg argues for underweighting a theme with poor cohesion despite positive momentum.
evidence: breadth 0.4 — weakest among top-4 eligible themes
durability_bar 0.48 below oil's 0.61 and base metals' 0.5
theses.dissent: Gold miners often act as a defensive hedge when geopolitical macro risk dominates (unscheduled_share 0.4); the momentum is still positive and eligible, and an underweight may miss a risk-off bid.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO breadth improves above 0.5 and score overtakes XEG.TO before the check-by
